name: interpreting-fetal-monitoring
description: Interprets intrapartum electronic fetal monitoring (EFM, fetal heart rate tracing, CTG strip) and reviews its charting using the 2008 NICHD definitions and the three-tier Category I, II and III system, applying the ACOG guidance in force on the date of care (Clinical Practice Guideline No. 10, October 2025, which replaced Practice Bulletins 106 and 116). Measures baseline and variability over 10-minute windows, accelerations by gestational age (15 x 15 at 32 weeks or later, 10 x 10 before 32 weeks), early, late, variable and prolonged decelerations by the 30-second rule and nadir timing, recurrence against contractions in 20-minute windows, and tachysystole averaged over 30 minutes. Flags maternal heart rate recorded as fetal, paper speed and clock mismatches, and Category II risk features. Supports concurrent documentation, quality and peer review, and retrospective medical-legal strip review with an outcome-blind first pass. Drafts for clinician review; no orders, standard-of-care or causation opinions.
